title: UAE E-Invoicing Starts 1 January 2027: 42 Days Left #Shorts
description:
UAE e-invoicing: businesses with revenue of AED 50 million or more go live on 1 January 2027. Under AED 50 million: appoint an accredited service provider by 31 March 2027 and go live on 1 July 2027. A PDF is not an e-invoice. Not having an accredited provider / system: AED 5,000 per month (FTA). Zoho (Zoho Software Trading LLC) is on the MoF list of accredited providers; Zoho Books sends e-invoices over Peppol.

Sources (checked 20 Nov 2026):
- UAE Ministry of Finance, e-invoicing: https://mof.gov.ae/en/about-us/initiatives/einvoicing/
- MoF accredited providers list: https://mof.gov.ae/en/about-us/initiatives/einvoicing/pre-approved-einvoicing-service-providers/
- UAE Electronic Invoicing Guidelines v2.0: https://mof.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/UAE-Electronic-Invoicing-Guidelines_En.pdf
- Zoho Books UAE e-invoicing: https://www.zoho.com/ae/books/e-invoicing/

General information, not tax or legal advice - check your own dates with the FTA or your adviser.
This video uses an AI-generated presenter (based on the creator), voice and animations. Facts are from the sources above.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation.
